decisions.reason: Technical validation and adoption within existing goals may proceed; validation is not semantic truth or product-performance proof.
Technical lessons may be reviewed and revoked within the existing authorized scope; preserve evidence and distinguish this from new value or permission choices.
Publishing private role memory outside its authorized scope changes permission and is not authorized by the existing technical work.

remaining: Run the existing role-memory and role-learning checks, then inspect their outputs and scope; passing checks do not establish independent memory benefit.
Design and run the bounded #23 comparison of ordinary search, role memory/search, and expertise-based agent queries, including wrong routing, stale knowledge, conflicts, revocation, and full costs.
Measure human review time and total model/token cost separately before making efficiency claims.
Keep proposed expert discovery/routing experimental until tested; do not publish private role memory outside authorized scope without a human permission decision.
